preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 3 * 10**5 for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and ' ' in line])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n (sea length) is between 1 and 300,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k <= 10**9 for k in [int(line.split()[1]) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and ' ' in line])
preconditions.description: For each test case, k (tide period) is between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= 10**9 for l in [int(line.split()[2]) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and ' ' in line])
preconditions.description: For each test case, l (max allowed depth) is between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(d) == n for n, _, _, *d in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and ' ' in line])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of depths matches n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= d_i <= 10**9 for d_i in [int(x) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and ' ' in line for x in line.split()[3:]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, each depth d_i is between 0 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output for each test case is either 'Yes' or 'No' (case-insensitive).

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.splitlines()[i].strip() == 'Yes' if any(all(d_i + p[t % (2 * k)] <= l for t in range(0, 2 * k)) for i in range(1, n + 1)) else 'No' for i in range(t))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'Yes' if there exists a path from shore (x=0) to island (x=n+1) where Koa can stay at each position x (1 ≤ x ≤ n) only at times t where the depth d_x + p[t % (2 * k)] ≤ l, otherwise 'No'.
